datasets.name: Upstream O&G Golden SIF Benchmark
datasets.purpose: Curated golden benchmark for evaluating SIF detection, Line-of-Fire precursors, and IOGP Life-Saving Rules concordance.
datasets.description: 14 authoritative high-consequence drilling, pressure testing, and confined space observation records curated by Senior HSE Officers.
datasets.source: Enterprise HSE Incident Management System & Field Review Queue

cases.input_text: During 10,000 psi hydrostatic pressure testing of choke manifold, pressure line whip check cable was found unfastened and swinging loose while line held 7,500 psi. Personnel were standing within 3 meters in the line of fire.
cases.actual_outcome: Near-miss with zero injuries. Test halted immediately by safety observer.
expected_precursors: High-pressure line testing with compromised restraint
Personnel inside line-of-fire zone

cases.input_text: Derrickman spotted standing on monkey board 90 feet above drill floor without secondary harness tether latched. Lanyard was draped over guardrail but carabiner was unlocked while latching drill pipe stands.
cases.actual_outcome: Observed during routine walkaround. Derrickman recalled and tether secured.
expected_precursors: Elevated work without verified primary fall arrest tethering

cases.input_text: Two contract technicians entered crude storage tank T-104 for desludging without continuous multi-gas monitor calibrated and without positive forced air ventilation duct running.
cases.actual_outcome: Atmosphere test at entry hatch showed 19.8% O2 and 12 ppm H2S. Work stopped immediately.
expected_precursors: Confined space entry without verified atmospheric monitoring or forced ventilation

cases.input_text: Mobile crane operator initiated 14-ton mud pump skid lift without taglines attached. Load swung abruptly when 25-knot gust hit, coming within 40 cm of pressurized gas separator line.
cases.actual_outcome: Near-impact with active separator process header. Load lowered to ground safely.
expected_precursors: Suspended heavy load lifting without tagline guide controls near pressurized assets
expected_exposure: Crane operating radius and process piping corridor

cases.input_text: Housekeeping observation: Plastic wrapping and two empty cardboard packaging boxes left near rig workshop entrance. Walkway remained unobstructed and dry.
cases.actual_outcome: Housekeeping noted; cleared during shift handover.

cases.input_text: Contractor safety glasses scratched on right lens. Employee requested replacement pair from warehouse tool crib prior to starting grinder cutting.
cases.actual_outcome: New PPE issued from stores.

cases.input_text: Hot work permit active for welding pipe support at crude manifold. Fire watch was present with dry chemical extinguisher, but spark containment blanket had a 30cm tear, allowing occasional sparks to drift toward oily sump pit.
cases.actual_outcome: Sparks extinguished before reaching vapor pocket. Sump covered with flame retardant tarp.
expected_precursors: Hot work spark containment breach adjacent to hydrocarbon vapor accumulation zone

cases.input_text: Forklift operator found driving at 15 km/h across warehouse apron without sounding horn at blind intersection. Pallet load of dry mud additives was securely shrink-wrapped.
cases.actual_outcome: No collision. Driver briefed on speed limits and blind spot sounding protocol.
expected_precursors: Mobile equipment operation without acoustic warning at blind corners

expected_barriers.barrier_name: Speed Limiter and Audible Horn Warning

cases.input_text: During pigging receiver barrel door opening on main sales gas pipeline, operator cracked bleed vent. A strong hissing sound occurred indicating trapped line pressure at 40 bar behind pig.
cases.actual_outcome: Door opening aborted. Valve reseated and secondary depressurization loop engaged.
expected_precursors: Vessel opening attempt with trapped pressurized gas behind stuck pig

cases.input_text: Report describes a field technician who slipped on muddy grass verge outside perimeter fence. Slight ankle roll with zero swelling; walked back to vehicle unassisted.
cases.actual_outcome: First aid kit applied cold pack as precaution. Full mobility.

cases.input_text: Subcontractor crew was excavating a 2.4 meter deep trench for instrument cable laying without trench box shoring or stepped benching. Soil was loose alluvial sand with heavy excavator idling 1 meter from trench lip.
cases.actual_outcome: HSE officer halted dig immediately. Workers evacuated from unshored trench.
expected_precursors: Unshored deep excavation exceeding 2m in loose soil with surcharge load on rim

cases.input_text: Electrical technician tested 440V motor control cabinet without verified lockout tagout padlocks affixed to main breaker. Assistant was standing nearby holding insulated probe.
cases.actual_outcome: Intervention by electrical lead. Breaker de-energized, LOTO lock applied.
expected_precursors: Work on 440V high-power distribution panel without verified physical LOTO lock

cases.input_text: Worker smelled faint sweet gas odor near flange at manifold header #3. Portable gas sensor detected intermittent 5% LEL hydrocarbons. Atmospheric test was inconclusive due to high cross-wind gusts.
cases.actual_outcome: Flange retorqued. Perimeter cordoned off pending repeat sniffer test.
expected_precursors: Intermittent hydrocarbon leak detection under fluctuating meteorological dispersion
cases.agreement_notes: Annotators split: Reviewer marked NEEDS_REVIEW due to gust dispersion uncertainty; Field lead argued SIF_POTENTIAL given proximity to generator ignition source.

cases.input_text: Valve handwheel had stiff rotational resistance during manual bypass operation. Valve was successfully closed by hand with extra torque applied.
cases.actual_outcome: Work order raised for grease lubrication.
expected_precursors: Manual valve actuation mechanical resistance requiring operator force

datasets.name: SUCHAK Regression & Boundary Suite
datasets.purpose: Regression test suite to catch performance drops in complex narratives, multilingual terminology, and borderline SIF cases.
datasets.description: 10 boundary condition safety reports testing model robustness across barrier bypass, partial energy isolation, and obscure hazard descriptions.
datasets.source: Phase 9 Human Review Queue Corrections & Field Calibration

cases.input_text: Rig floor mechanic cleared swarf from rotary table while Kelly bushing was rotating at slow idle (5 RPM). Loose sleeve came in contact with spinning shaft.
cases.actual_outcome: Shirt sleeve torn away. Zero flesh laceration.
expected_precursors: Working adjacent to unshielded rotating drill string machinery with entanglement exposure

cases.input_text: Nitrogen purging line quick-connect coupling blew free at 80 psi during pipeline pigging commissioning. Flying coupling struck barrier plywood sheet 1 meter from helper.
cases.actual_outcome: Impact punched hole in plywood. Zero bodily impact.
expected_precursors: Pneumatic pressure coupling detachment creating high-velocity projectile

cases.input_text: Scaffold toe-board missing on north deck face 40 feet above concrete hardstand. Heavy pipe wrench placed on scaffold edge vibrated by diesel generator.
cases.actual_outcome: Tool retrieved by rigger before dropping.
expected_precursors: Dropped object risk at height with compromised toe-board containment barrier

cases.input_text: Drinking water dispenser in control room recreation lounge was dripping onto rubber floor mat. Maintenance ticket logged for seal swap.
cases.actual_outcome: Mat replaced and water turned off.

cases.input_text: Radio communication crackle between banksman and crane operator during blind lift of casing elevator. Banksman immediately signaled emergency stop via air horn.
cases.actual_outcome: Radio swapped for backup handset; lift completed without incident.
expected_precursors: Loss of primary radio communication during critical blind tandem crane lift

cases.input_text: Driver of 20,000L crude tanker truck fell asleep for 2 seconds on highway approach curve. Vehicle tires crossed centerline into oncoming logging truck lane.
cases.actual_outcome: Rumble strips alerted driver. Swerved back safely.
expected_precursors: Heavy bulk hydrocarbon transport driver fatigue resulting in lane departure

cases.input_text: Mud engineer reported strong hydrogen sulfide (H2S) alert (25 ppm) on shaker deck. Windsock showed wind blowing toward mud logging cabin where door was propped open.
cases.actual_outcome: Auto deluge triggered, alarm sounded. Cabin evacuated.
expected_precursors: Toxic H2S gas ingress into positive pressure occupied accommodation enclosure
expected_exposure: Mud logging cabin interior and shale shaker house

cases.input_text: Loose gravel found scattered on external asphalt walking path near gatehouse. Foot traffic slow and path well lit.
cases.actual_outcome: Swept by gate security personnel.

cases.input_text: During rig mast lowering operation, crown block wireline snagged on derrick leg diagonal brace. Hydraulic cylinder pressure spiked to relief valve setting.
cases.actual_outcome: Mast lowering halted immediately. Snag freed manually with come-along hoist.
expected_precursors: Structural rigging hang-up during hydraulic mast handling causing severe bending moment

cases.input_text: Empty 20-liter lube oil drum was tipped on side in chemical containment berm. Drum was completely dry with zero residual oil.
cases.actual_outcome: Placed upright and stacked in scrap metal staging bin.

datasets.name: Synthetic Functional Smoke Benchmark [DEMO]
datasets.purpose: Rapid functional verification of evaluation runner, schema parsing, and quality gate triggers.
datasets.description: 6 synthetic test records clearly designated as simulated test fixtures. NOT intended as empirical proof of operational model accuracy.

expected_precursors: Elevated work without verified primary fall protection barrier

cases.input_text: [SYNTHETIC TEST CASE] Confined space entry into separator vessel without calibrated gas monitor or standby attendant.
expected_precursors: Confined space entry without verified atmospheric monitoring

cases.input_text: [SYNTHETIC TEST CASE] Office stationery cabinet door hinges squeaking upon opening. Harmless condition.
[SYNTHETIC TEST CASE] Water cooler puddle mopped and warning cone placed properly on tile hallway.
